definitions.explanation: The combined sound of many people talking, moving, or reacting at once. A low, unsettled buzz of activity or chatter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ざわめき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A murmur spread through the venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ざわめき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}まった→静まる：04580_shizumaru⟧。
examples.english: The commotion in the classroom died down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ざわめき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The moment of the announcement, the murmur of the audience turned into cheers all at once.

notes:
ざわめき is the noun form of ⟦ざわめく→ざわめく：07923_zawameku⟧ (to murmur, to buzz with activity). It describes the collective sound and atmosphere when many people are talking, reacting, or moving about.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ざわめき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: a murmur spreads
- ざわめき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}まる→静まる：04580_shizumaru⟧: the commotion dies down
- ざわめき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a stir arises
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ざわめき: the bustle of the city
- ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ざわめき: classroom chatter

RELATED ONOMATOPOEIA:
Derived from ⟦ざわざわ→ざわざわ：05985_zawazawa⟧, which evokes the sound and feel of restless commotion or unease. ざわめき is the more literary noun form.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ざわめき: murmur, buzz (of people, literary)
- ⟦がやがや→がやがや：06272_gayagaya⟧: noisy chatter (more casual, louder)
- ⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧: commotion, disturbance (stronger, implies disruption)
- ⟦{喧騒|けんそう}→喧騒：16870_kensou⟧: clamor, din (formal/literary)

REGISTER:
Slightly literary. Common in narrative prose, news, and descriptive writing.
